attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no asterisk. He is not the corpus's `augustine-of-hippo`. The page names many men around him and the corpus keeps none of them: Gregory the Great of Rome (12 Μαρτίου), Ethelbert king of Kent (24 Φεβρουαρίου, whom another reader has drafted as a new folder from saint.gr's 29 Μαΐου), Bede (27 Μαΐου), Mellitus of London (24 Απριλίου), Justus of Rochester (10 Νοεμβρίου), Paulinus of York (10 Οκτωβρίου), Rufinianus, Laurence, Peter, queen Bertha and the metropolitan Virgil of Arles. None is linked, because none has a folder yet. The forty monks who came with him are counted and not named, so they are no folders. Only the head line gives a year. No hymn.
